sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the petitioner submits that in this regard petitioner has filed representation before the Circle Officer, Jandaha, Vaishali but nothing happened.

5. Counsel for the State submits that Circle Officer is not appropriate authority under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
